**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (pending nothing — all gates green locally).

Thanks for a careful, well-documented fix — the `docs/decisions/` file made the review quick.

## What looks good

- `to_text`/`from_text` round-trip `Move::rotary` as ` SC<millidegrees>`, exactly the spelling the app golden writer already uses (`crates/app/tests/common/mod.rs:172`), and the reader matches the two-letter `SC` before the one-letter words, so it can't collide with the arc sense `S`. A path with no C still dumps byte-for-byte as before.
- `is_prismatic` (`crates/cl/src/cl/path.rs:109-113`) now refuses any path that states a C, which is the issue's "Done means" and correctly bumps the dump version to v4 (`text.rs:61`).
- `world_path` copies `rotary` at all six `Move` construction sites, chords included (`frame.rs`). This closes a more real gap than the issue first estimated: app rotary jobs go through this very function (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:2948`), so before the fix the C the rotary letter gate had just stamped (`generate.rs:3028-3033`) was silently dropped on the way to the world path — exactly the kind of silent wrong toolpath the Prime Directive forbids.
- Non-finite handling stays loud: `Toolpath::all_finite` covers `rotary` (`cl/moves.rs:166`) so the dump refuses it before the millidegree cast, and the reader's `with_rotary` refuses a non-finite angle by name. No new `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests.
- All three "Done means" items of #295 are pinned by named tests; no golden contains an `SC` word, so none moved (verified by grep over `crates/app/tests/golden`).
- Process is clean: conventional subject, `Changelog:` line, body ends `Fixes #295`, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit, decision file in `docs/decisions/`.

## Local results, merged with main

Trial merge with current `origin/main` was conflict-free (no code conflicts; nothing to resolve).

| Lane | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-cl --lib` | 32 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-cl --test headless_bin` | 3 passed, 0 failed |
| The three new tests run by name | all pass |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test multiaxis` | 7 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test ruling` | 10 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test operations` | 117 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored (heavy lanes) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test posed_contact` | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-cl --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

(Not run: the slow binaries — motion finish3d/pivot5d/flow, app center_cut_multiaxis — per the quick tier; and the ui snapshot suites, which this diff cannot affect.)

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `crates/cl/src/cl/frame.rs` is ~603 lines, already past the ~400 guideline; this PR grows it by only 4 net lines, but a future split along the seam would be welcome.
- Your report of the three ui pixel-snapshot failures reproducing identically on clean `main` reads as a snapshot-cache artifact of your machine, not a defect of this PR — nothing under `crates/ui` is touched here.
- The copy-rather-than-refuse choice in `world_path` is right today; if a tilted C-live setup is ever added, that combination will need to define what C means under the tilt at its own door, as your decision file says.
- One pre-existing asymmetry, unrelated to this PR and unchanged by it: `to_text` omits vertical `axis` poses, so a round-tripped move reads `axis: None` where it had `Some([0,0,1])` — `is_prismatic` treats those alike, so nothing depends on the difference.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
